settings.text: This rectangular folding table is a smart, space-saving solution for dining, work, study, or multipurpose use. Designed with a clean rectangular top and sturdy black metal legs, it offers a practical balance of style and function. The foldable frame makes it easy to store when not in use, while the wide tabletop provides enough room for laptops, meals, books, office tasks, or display items. Its minimalist industrial look fits well in modern homes, compact apartments, meeting areas, and workspaces. The lightweight yet stable construction makes it convenient to move, set up, and fold away as needed.

settings.heading: Product Specifications
settings.row_content:
• Foldable Frame: The table folds neatly for compact storage and easy handling when not in use.
  • Space-Saving Design: Ideal for homes, offices, and rooms where floor space matters.
  • Black Metal Legs: Sturdy metal legs provide dependable support and a stable base.
  • Secure Table Top: Similar tables use rigid tops with scratch-resistant and stain-resistant surfaces
  • Easy to Move: Lightweight folding structure makes repositioning simple.

settings.heading: Material
settings.row_content: Folding Tables is commonly made with a melamine, MDF, vinyl and laminated tabletop combined with metal legs and folding hardware. Black folding tables are often finished with scratch-resistant surfaces for easier maintenance.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
• Wipe the top regularly with a soft, dry or slightly damp microfiber cloth.
  • Use mild soap for routine cleaning, then dry the surface immediately.
  • Avoid abrasive pads, harsh cleaners, bleach, or acidic liquids.
  • Keep the folding mechanism clean and check joints occasionally for tightness.
  • Do not overload the table beyond safe use to preserve stability.
  • Store folded in a dry area when not in use to protect the frame and finish.
